pages.text: [#](53341a)Mandrake is never a polite harvest. Pulling a mature root by day has a **90% chance** to wake the shrieking creature instead of yielding the crop; at night that falls to **10%**. Peaceful difficulty prevents it entirely.[#]()
pages.title: Mandrake

pages.text: [#](53341a)An awakened root lunges at players, and contact brings fifteen seconds of nausea. Kill it to recover one Mandrake Root and one or two seeds.[#]()
[#](53341a)Leather and white wool. Worn on the head, they block the nausea scream — and blunt a Banshee's cry — so large harvests are far less miserable.[#]()
